## Upstream changes 1.18.0 -> 1.19.0

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — the upstream release notes for this range could not be retrieved, so there is no vendor text to confirm the upgrade is safe; the only confirmed change is the image's own version label.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes — the GitHub release notes for mintplexlabs/anythingllm could not be read (HTTP 404) for this range. Absence of notes is not evidence of absence of breaking changes.

### Variables
- none indicated. The registry diff shows only `DEPLOYMENT_VERSION: '1.18.0' -> '1.19.0'`, which is an internal label, not a variable the compose file or .env.example sets or consumes. No renamed, removed, or newly required variables are shown by the image diff, and no notes exist to name any.

### Data and dependencies
- none shown by the image diff beyond the version label itself (`DEPLOYMENT_VERSION`).
- Already true at the current version (not introduced by this range): the compose file requires `ANYTHINGLLM_PASSWORD` and `ANYTHINGLLM_JWT_SECRET` to be set (`AUTH_TOKEN: ${ANYTHINGLLM_PASSWORD:?set in .env...}`, `JWT_SECRET: ${ANYTHINGLLM_JWT_SECRET:?...}`), and SYS_ADMIN capability is deliberately withheld per the compose comments — these are standing requirements of the template, not changes in 1.18.0 -> 1.19.0.
- No companion-service version is named by any available notes (none were readable), so the "NEEDS ATTENTION forces DO NOT APPLY UNATTENDED" rule for an unpinned named dependency does not apply here — there is simply nothing to check it against.

### Before applying
- Take a known-good backup before touching the stack: the `backups` service already produces consistent SQLite + tar.gz snapshots in the `anythingllm-backups` volume — confirm a recent one exists before pulling the new image tag.
- Because the release notes are unavailable, manually check the following by hand before or right after upgrading:
  - The mintplexlabs/anythingllm GitHub releases page and CHANGELOG.md in the repo for the 1.18.0 -> 1.19.0 entries (the API call failed, but the web UI or a mirror may still have them).
  - The in-app migration log / server startup log after upgrade, since AnythingLLM sometimes runs silent schema migrations on boot.
  - Any change to the `/api/ping` healthcheck response or startup time (the compose healthcheck depends on `/usr/local/bin/docker-healthcheck.sh` inside the image; confirm it still exists/behaves the same in 1.19.0).
  - Whether the Ollama API surface or model-pull behavior this template relies on (`OLLAMA_BASE_PATH`, `OLLAMA_MODEL_PREF`) changed in the AnythingLLM release, since Ollama's own version here (0.40.11) is unaffected by this image's bump but compatibility is AnythingLLM's to declare.
- Update the pin in the compose file's `x-images` block (`ANYTHINGLLM_IMAGE_VERSION`) and its digest once satisfied, rather than floating the tag.

### Notes read
- Release notes could not be read: GitHub releases for mintplexlabs/anythingllm returned HTTP 404 for this range. No UPGRADING, BREAKING_CHANGES or CHANGELOG section was supplied either. Verdict and findings above rest solely on the registry image diff and the compose/.env.example contents.

## Upstream changes 0.40.11 -> 0.40.12

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — the notes add new model families and make internal performance/MLX/llama.cpp fixes; nothing in them touches configuration, variables, or deployment-visible behaviour, and the image configurations are confirmed identical where it matters.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none — no new, renamed or removed variables are mentioned, and `.env.example` / the compose file's `OLLAMA_INSTALL_MODELS` / `OLLAMA_IMAGE_VERSION` pins need no change

### Data and dependencies
- none. The notes mention no database, cache or search-engine version requirement at all, so there is nothing for the compose file to pin against.
- The new model families (LFM3, d1 2B) are opt-in via `ollama run`/`OLLAMA_INSTALL_MODELS`; the template's default (`llama3.2:3b`) is untouched. Per the notes: "Note: lfm3 and d1 2b are supported on Apple hardware in this release. Support for Linux/Windows coming soon." — not relevant to this Linux-container deployment.

### Before applying
- None required beyond the normal pin bump: update `OLLAMA_IMAGE_VERSION`/digest in the compose file's `x-images` block to 0.40.12 and its new sha256.

### Notes read
- v0.40.12 (2026-10-27) — the release being moved to.
- v0.40.11 (2026-10-24) — read only as the stated baseline, not as part of this upgrade's changes.

## Upstream changes 6.72.0 -> 6.73.0

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — this is a patch release containing only bug fixes, and the image diff shows no change to user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck or environment beyond the version string itself.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none

### Data and dependencies
- none. The release notes list bug fixes only (member imports, gallery reordering, tag filters, `{{encode}}` helper, member tier handling, fetch/jsdom, checkout redirect, Transistor card embeds, email click tracking). No database version requirement, migration, or schema change is mentioned.
- MySQL 8.4-oracle is the companion engine already pinned in the compose file at the baseline (6.72.0); this upgrade does not introduce or raise that requirement.

### Before applying
- None required beyond the normal good practice of taking a database/content backup before any image bump — the `backups` service already does this on schedule, but confirm a recent dump exists (`ghost-database-backups` / `ghost-data-backups` volumes) before pulling.
- Update the pin: change `GHOST_IMAGE_VERSION`/`GHOST_IMAGE_TAG` default in the compose `x-images` block (or `.env` override) from `6.72.0` to `6.73.0` with the matching digest, then `docker compose up -d`.

### Notes read
- v6.73.0 (2026-10-27) — the release being moved to
- v6.72.0 (2026-10-20) — baseline, read only to confirm no requirement already in force is being misreported as new

## Upstream changes 18.8.0-postgres-tomcat -> 18.9.0-postgres-tomcat

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — no upstream release notes are available for this move, so the application-level changes between 18.8.0 and 18.9.0 cannot be verified from text; the image diff itself is minor and consistent with a routine point release.

### Breaking changes
- Not available. XWiki does not publish release notes in this packaging repository (`xwiki/xwiki-docker is the packaging and tags no versions`). No UPGRADING, BREAKING_CHANGES or CHANGELOG section was supplied either. Check the XWiki release notes on xwiki.org for 18.9.0 by hand before applying — in particular for any noted data migration, extension-compatibility break, or configuration change between 18.8.0 and 18.9.0.

### Variables
- none — no compose variables, .env.example entries, or container environment variable names changed. The only environment differences are internal build-time values baked into the image (`XWIKI_VERSION`, `XWIKI_DOWNLOAD_SHA256`, `XWIKI_URL_PREFIX`, `POSTGRES_JDBC_*`), none of which are read from `.env` or overridable by the deployer.

### Data and dependencies
- The bundled PostgreSQL JDBC driver moves from 42.7.13 to 42.7.14 (`POSTGRES_JDBC_VERSION: '42.7.13' -> '42.7.14'`), a patch-level driver bump baked into the image, not something the host configures.
- The compose file pins PostgreSQL 15 (`postgres:${XWIKI_POSTGRES_IMAGE_VERSION:-15@sha256:...}`); the image diff does not mention any required PostgreSQL version change, so this pin is unaffected by the move.
- No ports, paths, volumes, or healthchecks differ between the two image configurations.
- Already true at the current version (not part of this upgrade): the postgres-tomcat image already requires PostgreSQL and a JDBC driver, both already running under 18.8.0.

### Before applying
- Take the usual backup before any XWiki version bump: this template already runs a scheduled backup job (`backups` service), confirm a recent dump exists (`POSTGRES_BACKUPS_PATH`, `DATA_BACKUPS_PATH`) before pulling 18.9.0.
- Manually check the XWiki 18.9.0 release notes on xwiki.org for any required extension updates, database migrations triggered on first startup, or deprecated configuration, since none of that is available from this image-diff/packaging source.
- No `.env` or compose edits are required; the version bump is driven entirely by the `XWIKI_IMAGE_VERSION`/digest pin in `x-images`.

### Notes read
- No upstream release notes were available for 18.8.0-postgres-tomcat -> 18.9.0-postgres-tomcat (packaging repository does not carry version-specific notes). No UPGRADING/BREAKING_CHANGES/CHANGELOG section was provided. Only the registry image-configuration diff was read.
